summary.name: Bauhaus is a supplemental design reference, not a directly named style in the source collection. Category is Graphic Design and Design Movements.
summary.visualIdentity: Circles, squares, triangles, rules and lettering share one grid with asymmetric balance. Forms grow, rotate and interlock in rhythmic stages. The 120 px grid is an optional starting parameter, not a defining feature.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit fits: posters and identity built from primitives, staged geometric assembly, and music-backed loops. Inferred fits: section transitions and explanatory geometry. The subject and audience are unspecified in this style record.
summary.limitations: Source notes say grid size, tempo and beat count were not verified in the source video. Primary-color geometry alone does not make a piece Bauhaus. Phrase and punctuation references need actual scene text or approved marks. Morphs must avoid organic, liquid-like midpoints.
summary.palette: Background policy is scene_dependent, so #FFFFFF is only an illustrative swatch; choose a background from the scene. Suggested roles are foreground #000000 and accents #D62828, #F2C230 and #164B9B. These are authored suggestions, not approved exact colors, and gradients are disabled. Two-color contrast is 21:1 for black on white, 12.5:1 for black on yellow, 8.4:1 for white on blue and 5.0:1 for white on red. Verify these in composited frames.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Primary motion is staged assembly using growth, rotation and interlocking, with sharp cuts and reading holds preserved. Motion references 007, 012 and 015 cover pinned recomposition, chaptered handoffs and story steps. References 037 to 039 cover phrase scatter, punctuation zoom and radial burst. Each reference is optional and used only when scene assets support its action. Video output is driven by composition time, not live pointer or scroll input.
summary.audio: No audio is specified, and silence is valid. A suggested direction is optional background music tied to a verified beat or section table, without autoplay or full-frame flashing on every beat. Voiceover and sung vocals are unspecified. The 120 BPM and 20-beat values are examples only, so measured soundtrack timing is required before syncing.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploads are specified or required by this style record. Fonts must be local and loaded before animation begins. Shapes can be generated in code from the grid. Reference 038 needs an actual punctuation mark, and reference 039 needs an approved mark. Do not invent copy or brand marks, and any audio must be authorized or created locally.
summary.combinations: Style-100 (shape morphing, SVG plus GSAP) suits transitions between circle, square and triangle states. Morphs must stay between primitives, use one flat color per shape with snapped color changes, and align pivots to the grid. Style-105 is a timing-only engine that drives assembly from one shared beat or section table, with no visuals. Both combinations are suggestions, and the five discrete base colors must stay fixed.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer: SVG for grid geometry and text, with optional p5.js for generative layers redrawn explicitly from composition time. Motion engine: one paused, seekable GSAP timeline; Motion or Anime.js is optional only with separate property ownership. Pipeline: HyperFrames is primary, with check, snapshot and render steps. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames cannot meet a documented requirement.
